products.title: 6ft Heavy-Duty Folding Table – Portable, Durable & Easy Setup
products.description:
6ft Heavy-Duty Folding Table

Upgrade your event setup with our 6ft Heavy-Duty Folding Table, designed for vendors, trade shows, and outdoor events. This versatile, durable table provides a reliable surface for product displays, food service, or marketing materials.

💪 Heavy-Duty Construction: Built with a high-strength steel frame and reinforced plastic tabletop for long-lasting durability.

📏 Spacious Surface: 6ft length provides ample space for serving, display, or workspace needs.

⚙️ Folding Design: Easily collapses for compact storage and quick transport.

🚚 Portable & Lightweight: Designed for easy carrying to events and setups.

🧽 Easy to Clean: Smooth surface resists stains and is simple to wipe down after use.

🎯 Multi-Purpose Use: Ideal for trade shows, food booths, vendor markets, parties, and outdoor events.

Materials

- Frame: Steel

- Tabletop: High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE)

Primary Usage

Trade shows, food booths, vendor markets, catering, and outdoor events

products.description:
8ft Heavy-Duty Folding Table

Take your booth or event setup to the next level with our 8ft Heavy-Duty Folding Table, built for durability, stability, and convenience. Perfect for trade shows, food booths, catering, and outdoor events, this table provides extra space without compromising portability.

💪 Heavy-Duty Construction: Sturdy steel frame and reinforced high-density plastic tabletop designed to support heavy loads and withstand daily use.

📏 Extra-Large Surface: 8ft length offers generous workspace for product displays, food service, or multi-purpose setups.

⚙️ Folding Design: Easily folds in half for compact storage and transport.

🚚 Portable & Lightweight: Despite its size, the table is easy to move and set up anywhere.

🧽 Easy to Clean: Smooth, non-porous surface wipes clean quickly after use.

🎯 Versatile Applications: Ideal for trade shows, food booths, vendor markets, catering services, and outdoor events.

Materials

- Tabletop: High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE)

products.title: Draped Table Cover (Full-Color Dye Sublimation, Full Bleed)
products.description:
Create a polished, professional table display with our Draped Table Cover, designed to deliver full-bleed branding with a classic, elegant look. Ideal for trade shows, vendor booths, corporate events, and promotional displays, this table cover provides a clean presentation while allowing easy access underneath the table.

Printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation, your artwork appears vibrant, sharp, and long-lasting. The draped polyester fabric hangs naturally on all sides, creating a refined appearance that works across a wide range of event environments.

🔹 Key Features

- 🧵 Display Polyester Fabric – Smooth draped finish for a professional look

- 🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Vivid, fade-resistant graphics

- 🖼️ Full Bleed Printing – Edge-to-edge custom branding

- 📏 Multiple Sizes Available – Fits standard 4ft, 6ft, and 8ft tables

- ⚙️ Easy Setup – Simple drape-on design for fast installation

- 🧳 Lightweight & Portable – Easy to fold and transport

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation (Full Bleed)

🔹 Materials

🧵 Fabric: Display Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, exhibitions, vendor booths, conferences, retail promotions, pop-up shops, and brand activations.

products.title: Fitted Table Cover  (Full-Color Dye Sublimation, Full Bleed)
products.description:
Create a polished, professional table display with our Fitted Table Cover, designed to deliver full-bleed, edge-to-edge branding with a tailored, structured fit. Ideal for trade shows, vendor booths, exhibitions, and corporate events, this cover instantly elevates your brand presentation while maintaining a clean and organized look.

Printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation, your artwork appears vibrant, sharp, and long-lasting. The fitted design covers three sides of the table, leaving the back open for easy storage access—making it a practical and cost-effective solution for busy event environments.

🔹 Key Features

- 🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Crisp, vibrant, fade-resistant graphics

- 🖼️ Full Bleed Printing – Edge-to-edge custom branding

- 🧵 Display Polyester Fabric – Durable material with a professional finish

- 📐 Fitted Table Design – Clean, tailored look for event tables

- 📦 Open Back (Economy Style) – Easy access for storage under the table

- 🎒 Optional Carry Bag – Convenient transport and storage

🔹 Available Table Sizes

- 📏 8ft Table: 96"W × 30"H × 30"D

- 📏 6ft Table: 72"W × 30"H × 30"D

- 📏 4ft Table: 48"W × 30"H × 24"D

- 📏 4ft Tall Table: 48"W × 36"H × 24"D

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation (Full Bleed)

🔹 Materials

🧵 Fabric: Display Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, exhibitions, vendor booths, conferences, retail promotions, pop-up shops, brand activations, and corporate events.

products.title: Stretch Table Cover (Full-Color Dye Sublimation, Full Bleed)
products.description:
Create a clean, professional presentation with our Stretch Table Cover, designed to deliver edge-to-edge (full bleed) branding with a sleek, wrinkle-free fit. Perfect for trade shows, events, vendor booths, and promotions, this cover transforms standard tables into polished brand displays.

Printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation on Power Stretch polyester material, your artwork appears vibrant, sharp, and long-lasting. A rear zipper closure ensures a snug, tailored fit that stays in place throughout your event while maintaining a smooth, professional look.

🔹 Key Features

- 🧵 Power Stretch Polyester Fabric – Durable, wrinkle-resistant, and form-fitting

- 🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Vibrant, fade-resistant custom graphics

- 🖼️ Full Bleed Printing – Edge-to-edge branding coverage

- 🔒 Rear Zipper Closure – Secure, snug fit with a clean finish

- 📏 Multiple Size Options – Available for 4ft, 6ft, and 8ft tables

- 🧳 Carry Bag Included – Easy transport and storage

- ⚙️ Easy Setup – Slip-on design for fast installation

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation (Full Bleed)

🔹 Materials

🧵 Fabric: Stretch Polyester Blend

🔹 Compatibility

📐 Designed to fit standard event tables (size options available)

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, exhibitions, vendor booths, conferences, retail promotions, pop-up shops, and brand activations.

products.title: Table Runner (Full-Color Dye Sublimation, Full Bleed)
products.description:
Enhance your table presentation with our Custom Table Runner, designed to add bold branding and a professional touch to any event setup. Perfect for trade shows, vendor booths, conferences, and promotions, this runner delivers high-impact visuals without covering the entire table.

Printed using full-color dye sublimation with full bleed, your artwork appears vibrant, crisp, and long-lasting. The sleek runner design allows your brand to stand out while maintaining a clean, modern table display.

🔹 Key Features

- 🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Sharp, vibrant, fade-resistant graphics

- 🖼️ Full Bleed Printing – Edge-to-edge custom branding

- 🧵 Display Polyester Fabric – Smooth finish with professional drape

- ⚙️ Easy Setup – Simply lay over any standard table

- 🧳 Lightweight & Portable – Ideal for travel and events

- 🏷️ Versatile Branding – Perfect accent for existing table covers

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation (Full Bleed)

🔹 Materials

🧵 Fabric: Display Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, exhibitions, vendor booths, conferences, retail promotions, pop-up shops, brand activations, and corporate events.
